properties.name: A claim derived under a supposition that is now refuted reads that it rests on a refuted supposition, not as an open conditional that still holds
properties.statement:
A step that assumes a supposition holds inside the hypothetical, which is correct logic. But once the supposition itself reads refuted outside, the claims derived under it read "rests on a refuted supposition (S)". They no longer count as live conditional support or as a standing objection, and the what-if names them.
MEASURED 2026-10-19 in the FICTIONAL capstone: after U1, S2 ("the export variant's capabilities are in the fielded radar") read REFUTED, yet H-agile's step from R3 under S2 still read "holds", "assumed… held inside it whatever its own truth".
